🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — September 19, 2026

Moon, in detriment in Capricorn, holds a square to Neptune, in Aries. Two different appetites, forced into one conversation: what you hold is weighed against what it cost to hold it.

Easier — Seeing the real cost of an arrangement you had stopped examining.
Harder — Defending a position you no longer hold for reasons you no longer have.
Backdrop — Jupiter and Saturn hold a month-long trine underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, falls in Cancer. It sextiles Sun in Virgo. Moon squares you from Capricorn, and the cost objects. Fire moves first and pays first. It has held two weeks without changing its terms.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you, exiled in Scorpio. Moon trines you from Capricorn, and the ease asks its own attention. Earth keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. The Libra chapter closed four weeks ago.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you from Libra, untitled. From Virgo, Sun cuts across the appetite. Mutable air: keeping options is the expense. Mercury left Leo four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, is in detriment in Capricorn. Sun sextiles you from Virgo: a door left ajar. Water begins, and beginning asks little today. A week ago Moon was still held by Mercury; that is finished.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, crosses Virgo untitled. Mercury sextiles you from Libra: help that waits to be asked for. Fire keeps what it has, cheaply. The same angle for two weeks, and the price has stopped moving.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury governs you, untitled in Libra. Moon trines you from Capricorn, meeting no resistance. Mutable earth: two answers, and both are affordable. The conjunction to Moon that held a week ago has let go.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you, out of place in Scorpio. Moon squares you from Capricorn, and something has to give way. Cardinal air: the beginning has a price on it. The hold Moon had two weeks ago is not there any more.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars governs you, unsupported in Cancer. Moon in Capricorn makes room for you, and then waits. Fixed water keeps what it has, and keeping is easy. What pressed two weeks ago has cleared.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. Sun in Virgo presses on you, and the pressure is arithmetic. Mutable fire: every option kept is an option paid for. The sextile of four weeks ago is off it now.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Moon is in your sign now, handling what you own at close range. Earth begins and is billed in the same gesture. Moon let go of it a week ago.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn rules you from Aries, without leverage of its own. Venus squares you from Scorpio: wanting and cost refuse to agree. Fixed air pays to hold on. This was not here last week, and has no history yet.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. Moon in Capricorn opens a gap you have to step into. Water that changes shape, and the shape fits. A week ago there was nothing here to describe.
